points: 6,774 merged PRs from Codex, Devin, Copilot, Cursor and Claude Code across 891 repositories, against 5,044 human PRs
4.5% of agent merges got a verified fix within 30 days; odds 1.62 times those of human merges
About 70% of those fixes came from the same agent; preprint, not yet peer reviewed
take: A large preprint gives a hard quality number for agent-written code. Useful benchmark when setting review and post-merge checks for coding agents.
title: Deakin study: merged coding-agent PRs need fixes more often than human ones
